ttm.note: Q1 FY2027 quarterly 6-K filed 2026-07-29 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) is the latest financial report filed by 2026-10-21; later 6-Ks (Aug 10 AGM notice, Sep 10 AGM results, Sep 18 UK annual report) carry no new financials. TTM = FY2026 (20-F) + Q1 FY2027 - Q1 FY2026. Debt = finance leases only: current 21 from 6-K plus non-current 34 carried from the March 31 20-F (not disclosed in the 6-K; upper bound). Shares are filed rounded to 1,068 million (20-F cover gave 1,068,078,760 at May 21, 2026, consistent). Unvested awards 24 million rounded, excludes PSUs without a grant date and the 425,000 CEO VCP PSUs. EDA liabilities 148 listed as otherClaims. notes: Arm files 20-F (annual) and 6-K (quarterly report on Q1-Q3 as 6-K, with GAAP statements), not 10-K/10-Q. Fiscal year ends March 31.
Annual base = FY2026 (year ended 2026-03-31; 20-F filed 2026-05-26). TTM base = twelve months to 2026-06-30 using the Q1 FY2027 6-K (filed 2026-07-29).
Currency USD; all statements US GAAP in USD millions.
carriedFrom used once (TTM non-current finance lease, from the 20-F). 6-K does not disclose option/RSU detail beyond rounded millions and does not give an exact share count.

Reviewed package incremental-ARM-2026-10-20-v3 uses a conservative finance-lease bound of 70 (21 + 49 all other non-current liabilities); this file uses 21 + 34 = 55 which follows the filed 20-F split.
